purpose.domain_detail: Compiler/runtime test for numeric COMP-3 data items with various PIC scaling (P), sign, and decimal (V) combinations
purpose.summary: This program declares 63 COMP-3 numeric working-storage items covering all combinations of P-scaling (leading and trailing), V decimal, sign options (trailing, leading separate, trailing separate), and signed/unsigned variants. The procedure division simply DISPLAYs each variable to verify correct storage and display behavior.

notable_features: All 63 PIC clauses use COMP-3 (packed decimal)
Extensive use of P scaling character in PIC strings (PP99, 99PP, etc.)
All sign variants tested: implicit, SIGN TRAILING, SIGN LEADING SEPARATE, SIGN TRAILING SEPARATE
No PERFORM, CALL, GOTO, or file I/O — pure data declaration and DISPLAY test
verdict.notes: The file is clearly a test/sample program designed to exercise numeric COMP-3 picture clause variations. The 'samplel' filename (letter l, not number 1) and generic program-id 'prog' are consistent with GnuCOBOL or similar open-source compiler test suites. No ambiguity about it being genuine COBOL.
